title: Father & Son Cutting Birthday Cake, 1950s B&W Kitchen Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Dad + Cary - cutting birthday cake. 4 yrs Sept 17 1955
description: A black and white 1955 family snapshot capturing a father standing behind his 4-year-old son, Cary, as they cut a frosted birthday cake together at the kitchen table. In the background, a vintage General Electric refrigerator is prominently featured, evoking a quintessential mid-century American domestic scene during the post-WWII era.
